spot.quality: The normalized cross-venue reference gap was approximately 0.0036%, but the observations are asynchronous; Kraken supplies no provider timestamp. The 24-hour windows and quote currencies differ. This is not an executable arbitrage signal.

derivatives.source_scope: all exchanges as represented by Liqwall

derivatives_quality.policy: Do not average provider totals. Venue coverage and aggregation differ. Both show positive funding and long-heavy liquidations, but the aggregate values are not independent market participants and do not establish direction.

etf_flows.method: Issuer-file holdings change; no zero-fill; USD uses provider's own XRP/USD close

etf_flows.quality_note: The page claims five funds but the visible detailed table shows four rows and does not show TOXR; its fund universe and Canary component differ from CryptoKeyhole.

market_snapshot.etf_quality: The providers are separate publishers but share issuer-file upstream data; they are not independent source groups. Holdings changes do not prove exchange sales, cash redemptions or XRP bridge demand. Preserve partial coverage and disagreement; do not average.

macro.model_quality_rule: Encode the missing year-over-year observations as unavailable; never zero-fill or backfill. No causal XRP event attribution is supported by this single observation.
